caseName: H. L. Moore Drug Exchange v. Lilly
caseNameFull: H. L. Moore Drug Exchange, a Division of Levitt Industries, Inc. v. Eli Lilly & Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of petitioners to defer consideration of the petition for writ of certiorari denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
